provenance: Project HERCULES | owner the owner | [id removed]
declaration: RULES.md DECL-P4-12 (P4-L) item 1; channel of DECL-P4-6 item 2
written_before: any threshold voxel and any tile pixel is computed
level_choice_reason: native 2.4 um voxels, no in-plane pre-averaging before the max; measured throughput (4 processes x 16 range-request threads, ~500 req/s, ~100 MB/s) makes all 160 level-0 tiles feasible in about 30-40 min, so level 1 is not needed for time

slab.rule: +-15 um around the mesh surface at 2.4 um/slice -> +-6 slices (DECL-P4-6 item 2: 13 slices at 2.4 um)

projection: per canvas px, max over the 13 slab slices of the level-0 uint8 voxels (canvas px (i, j) = level-0 (row i, col j)); a missing chunk (404) is fill 0; px beyond the level-0 array are 0

display.value: clip(255*(max - T_mid)/(T_hi - T_mid), 0, 255), rounded half-to-even (np.rint) to uint8; 0 outside mesh-valid

grid.mesh_valid: strip-a canvas_mask rule verbatim (canvas px (i,j) -> grid (i*gh//H, j*gw//W)) on the official tifxyz 20260701183124-on-20260411134726-2.4um
grid.eligibility: valid_fraction >= 0.5; must reproduce exactly the 160 eligible (r, c) of the pairs0814b e2 manifest (sha256 462909e1310369194e6321513aef3010f922dcea1d33c29afe627c48a8850210), with identical valid_fraction and valid_px; otherwise the build stops

thresholds_method.material: known-text control 20260701183125-w028-037, surface volume 2.4um-0.22m-78keV-volume-20260411134726.zarr (exists in the bucket: level-0 shape (109, 71600, 174640))
thresholds_method.mesh: official tifxyz 20260701183125-on-20260411134726-2.4um (sha256 x da81.. see thresholds.json)
thresholds_method.voxels: all 13 slab voxels at every mesh-valid canvas px (same canvas_mask rule) of the sampled control tiles
thresholds_method.tile_subsample: control canvas tiled with the same T = 8343 from (0, 0); eligible = valid_fraction >= 0.5; sample n = ceil(0.10 * n_eligible) tiles (>= 5 %) drawn by numpy.random.default_rng(20260926).choice(n_eligible, n, replace=False) over the eligible list in (r, c) order
thresholds_method.statistics: exact, from the integer histogram of the uint8 voxels: T_mid = the median, T_hi = the 99.9th percentile, both as the inverted-CDF quantile (smallest v with CDF(v) >= q)
thresholds_method.frozen: thresholds.json is pushed before any E2 tile is computed and is never changed afterwards

per_tile_numbers: valid_fraction, valid_px, stats of the slab max at mesh-valid px (mean, std, p1, p50, p99, p99.9, min, max), frac of valid px with max > T_hi, n_hi = slab voxels > T_hi at valid px, frac of valid px with max == 0, frac of output px == 0 / == 255, chunks read / missing; numbers only
order: rows r0 and r1 first (DECL-P4-12 item 5), then r2..r8; 4 worker processes on one tile queue
viewing: no tile, slice or pixel is ever opened, viewed or described by the builder
